tasks.label: backup-local-db
args: $dbDir = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Playlist'; $dbPath = Join-Path $dbDir 'playlist.db'; $backupDir = Join-Path $dbDir 'backups'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null; if (Test-Path $dbPath) { $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $target = Join-Path $backupDir ('playlist-' + $ts + '.db'); Copy-Item $dbPath $target -Force; Write-Host ('Backed up DB to ' + $target); } else { Write-Host 'No local DB found to back up.'; }

tasks.label: remove-local-db
args: $dbPath = Join-Path (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Playlist') 'playlist.db'; if (Test-Path $dbPath) { Remove-Item $dbPath -Force; Write-Host ('Removed local DB at ' + $dbPath); } else { Write-Host 'No local DB found to remove.'; }

tasks.label: clean-build
args: dotnet clean src/Playlist/Playlist.csproj; dotnet build src/Playlist/Playlist.csproj --configuration Debug
